portfolio.notes: CBOE uses underscore prefix _SPX for index options. Yahoo v7 options does not reliably serve SPX chains — use CBOE only.

portfolio.instrument: TSM 6M ~90% protective put (Taiwan tail hedge, N6)
portfolio.notes: N6: promoted from signal-only (extra_underlyings) to the PRICED chain list so weekly ingests now capture TSM into chains/. The put TRADE_39 is DEFERRED and NOT yet in portfolio.json: CBOE serves current chains only and TSM's chain history starts 2026-07-24, so it cannot price at the 2026-07-10 valuation date. Add TRADE_39 (a ~90% 6M protective put on the #2 TSM long) once the book's valuation date advances to a date with a TSM chain, then add chains/TSM_chains.csv to configs/marketdata/dq_gate.json. See docs/design/portfolio_rebalance_review.md.

notes: Option chains: weekly snapshots only (CBOE delayed free tier does not provide historical chains). Each run appends a dated snapshot to the per-ticker CSV.
VIX and vol indices: full history available free from CBOE (VIX back to 1990). Time window applies for filtering after download.

signals.description: Point-in-time option-implied signals derived from the chain snapshots (market-intelligence B1). A DERIVATION, not a download: signals_runner reads every chain in chain_dirs, computes per-(underlying, snapshot_date) signals, and writes signals/option_signals.csv (+ provenance sidecar, gated in dq_gate.json). Consumed by scenariogen/options (B4) and the BFF (B6). Reads chains from BOTH chains/ (priced) and chains_signals/ (signal-only), so all 14 portfolio underliers with a chain are covered.

cboe_chains.name: CBOE Delayed Option Chains
cboe_chains.description: Primary option chain source. One JSON call per underlying returns the complete chain across all expiries (~15-min delayed). No auth. CBOE ticker for index options uses underscore prefix: _SPX, _NDX.
cboe_chains.extra_underlyings_note: Underliers with NO option trade in the book, downloaded for their option-implied signals rather than to price a position (market-intelligence P0/B0). ORCL and META matter most -- they are the CDS/bond issuers (#17/#18, #28/#29) where equity-option signals are a classic credit early-warning. Same schema as `portfolio`, but written to a SEPARATE directory (`signal_output_dir`) NOT `chains/`. Reason: the pricer's content-addressed market-data snapshot globs `options/chains/*.csv`, and a signal-only chain must not enter the PRICING fingerprint (it would churn the pricing snapshot_id -- and force golden re-baselines -- on every signal refresh, though the pricer never reads it). P1 signal code reads from `chains_signals/`; the pricer's `equity_adapter` reads `chains/` by underlier name and is unaffected.

cboe_vol_indices.name: CBOE Volatility Index History
cboe_vol_indices.description: VIX, VVIX, and term-structure vol indices (VIX9D, VIX3M, VIX6M, SKEW). Full daily history downloaded as CSV. Used to anchor ATM vol level for swaption + cap calibration and equity stress scenarios.

indices.VIX: S&P 500 Volatility Index — primary market vol gauge
indices.VVIX: Vol-of-vol (VIX of VIX) — tail risk indicator
indices.SKEW: CBOE SKEW Index — tail risk / put skew
indices.VXN: Nasdaq-100 volatility index -- the correct vol factor for QQQ (#14), which was proxied to VIX
indices.RVX: Russell 2000 volatility index -- small-cap vol, the non-mega-cap leg of a rotation
indices.VXD: Dow Jones volatility index -- value/industrial vol, contrast to VXN in a style rotation
indices.VXTLT: 20+yr Treasury ETF volatility index -- long-duration rates vol, cross-check on MOVE
indices.VXEEM: Emerging-markets ETF volatility index -- EM/Taiwan stress read for TSM (#2) and the TWD leg (#26)
indices._OIV: NOT INGESTED -- CBOE crude-oil ETF vol index. The endpoint still returns 200 but the series is DISCONTINUED: it stops at 2022-11-07 (214 rows). Verified 2026-07-23 during P0. Kept here as a record so it is not re-proposed; a 200 status is not evidence of a live series.
indices.DSPX: S&P 500 Dispersion Index -- index vol vs constituent vol; the ETF-vs-basket basis (FINDING 3) and SMH/XLK hedge failure
indices.COR3M: 3-month implied correlation -- longer-horizon companion to COR1M

yahoo_options.name: Yahoo Finance Options — Fallback Chains (DISABLED)
yahoo_options.description: Yahoo Finance v7/finance/options now requires a session crumb (CSRF token) that must be obtained by warming up a full browser session. The crumb endpoint (query2.yahoo.com/v1/test/csrfToken) is not accessible programmatically without browser cookies. CBOE delayed JSON provides a complete, higher-quality chain (pre-computed greeks, all expiries, no auth) — Yahoo is redundant.
